contents.content: There are 10-15 questions. There is no time limit.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Report details, reasons, or results of events or actions.
  • Express annoyance, willingness and refusal, and make promises and threats.
  • Talk about past habits.
  • Express beliefs, opinions, and intention to do something.
  • Say and use words like legacy, philosophy, employee, classic, identify, Armenian, petition, decision, Japanese and engineer.

contents.content: 10. Marianne talks about politics and society.
Instructions: Read the hint. Organize the mystery sentence. Move each word to place it in the correct order.

_data.content: I believe that everyone can make changes to improve society .
